title: AAPS sometimes stops at night
body:
Reporting bugs
--------This is the second time AAPS has stopped overnight after viewing the summary screen. As soon as you want to view the screen again, the system will reboot and continue without any problems.
I'm using the latest version. This problem does not occur during the day.
See log at time 05:43

------
[AndroidAPS._2022-02-07_05-43-37_.0.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/8013466/AndroidAPS._2022-02-07_05-43-37_.0.zip)

comments.body: no sign of crash in log. Hard to help. you should review battery saving settings for AAPS or ask in FB group for hints for you phone model
